Rule graph — what goes on the rule nodes

Only items were labelled because that is the convention in the reference plots — the rule circle means something through its size, colour and position, not its name. The cost is that you cannot tell which circle is which rule. label_rules now decides.

FALSE — bare (current default, the convention)

“id” — R1, R2, … cross-referenced to rules()

Each circle can now be looked up in the table below the plot.
